identity.title: Rapid and sensitive on-site detection of PBoV G3 using an EsCas13d-based platform.

content.abstract: Rapid, sensitive, and user-friendly nucleic acid diagnostic methods are crucial for controlling the spread of PBoV G3. In this study, we developed SENTRY (Single-step Enzymatic Nucleic acid Targeted Reporter Yield), a pathogen detection platform designed for on-site deployment in resource-limited settings. Combined with GENE (General Extraction-free Nucleic acid Exposure reagent), a room-temperature lysis protocol, SENTRY can release viral nucleic acids within 5 min. The addition of accessory proteins enhances the sensitivity of the one-step SENTRY platform and shortens the reaction time. SENTRY provides results within 30 min, with clinical sample detection rates matching those of qPCR, and shows no cross-reactivity with non-target viruses. The system operates efficiently at body temperature ( approximately 37  degrees C) without requiring temperature control devices. Lyophilized reagents make SENTRY robust to transport conditions and extend shelf life. Overall, these features make SENTRY highly suitable for POCT outside conventional laboratory environments.
